segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר שרוחניות הקשור בגשמיות אל ירבו בזה (למשל אפי' אכילה שלמצות או שאר מצות שיש הנאה בגשמיות אל ירבו מזה):
segments.en: Reb Yudel — when he drew close to Rabbainu (and several stories are cited in Kokhav Or) — he was already old and greatly famous in the world, a distinguished disciple of the holy Tzaddik Reb Pinchas of Koritz. Rabbainu would call him just "Yudel" — without the title "Reb" — as he called his other disciples. This distressed Reb Yudel. When Rabbainu saw it upset him, he called him "Reb Yudel." But afterward, once Reb Yudel understood Rabbainu's greatness, he very much wanted Rabbainu to call him simply "Yudel" — as Rabbainu called Reb Noson. But Rabbainu did not want to.
